patch_description: This design extends the strongest higher-order interaction pattern from the prior candidates into a complementary dual-hyperedge structure. It retains independent RY amplitudes and symmetry-shared RZ phases, then adds ZZZ interactions on [2,4,6] and [1,3,8] to model two distinct three-body correlations. To control depth and gate count, the less critical CZ edge [3,5] is removed. Thus, higher-order expressivity is increased without enlarging the per-block gate count relative to the single-ZZZ design.
